stage: Diagnostic rerun of scoped whitespace preflight after the initial publisher stopped before commit/tag/push
cause: Raw CRLF snapshot bytes were correctly preserved, but -text alone did not disable textual diff whitespace interpretation. Only raw snapshots require binary attributes; runtime and readable evidence remain text-checked.
resolution: Set owned *.snapshot binary (-text -diff -merge), preserve all snapshot bytes, rerun focused verification and publish via the authorized publisher.
